definitions.gloss: to fear, to be afraid of

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{恐|おそ}れる→恐れる：02023_osoreru⟧。
⟦{恐|おそ}れ{入|い}ります→恐れ入ります：17552_osoreirimasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧。
examples.english: I'm sorry to trouble you, but...

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{恐|おそ}れる→恐れる：02023_osoreru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There's nothing to be afraid of.

notes:
A literary verb meaning "to fear," the classical form of ⟦{恐|おそ}れる→恐れる：02023_osoreru⟧. Only a few of its classical forms survive, in set expressions such as {恐|おそ}るべき 'formidable', {恐|おそ}る⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ 'nothing to fear' and ⟦{恐|おそ}る{恐|おそ}る→恐る恐る：12609_osoruosoru⟧. It has no modern paradigm of its own, so this entry has no conjugation table.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {恐|おそ}る

FORMS:
- {恐|おそ}る: classical form (literary; fixed expressions only)
- ⟦{恐|おそ}れる→恐れる：02023_osoreru⟧: ichidan form (standard modern usage)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{恐|おそ}れ{入|い}ります→恐れ入ります：17552_osoreirimasu⟧: I'm sorry to trouble you (very polite, used in business/service)
- ⟦{恐|おそ}る{恐|おそ}る→恐る恐る：12609_osoruosoru⟧: timidly, gingerly (reduplication)
- ⟦{恐|おそ}らく→おそらく：02492_osoraku⟧: probably, perhaps (adverb from an old form of this verb)

COMMON PATTERNS (using ⟦{恐|おそ}れる→恐れる：02023_osoreru⟧):
- ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{恐|おそ}れる→恐れる：02023_osoreru⟧: to fear failure
- ⟦{恐|おそ}れる→恐れる：02023_osoreru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there's nothing to fear

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{恐|おそ}れ→恐れ：05405_osore⟧: fear (noun)
- ⟦{恐|おそ}ろしい→恐ろしい：02338_osoroshii⟧: frightening, terrible (adjective)
- ⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧: scary (more colloquial)
